annotation.equivalence_rationale: All three responses use the same core operational evidence (handover records/notes, revised schedule, task list) to assess the relocation plan, identify and resolve the ownership dispute with the teams, adjust timing around clearly defined tasks, and document reasons for changes. The wording and level of detail differ, but there is no substantive change in the evidence used, the coordination approach, or the decision traceability commitments under the three criteria.
